hooks.name: Regression Check After Critical Module Save

action.prompt:
A critical trading module file was just saved in the MoneyPrinter project. Run these targeted regression checks:

1. Run TypeScript check: `cd /Users/manishkumar/Desktop/money-printer && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20`

2. Run the watchdog test suite: `cd /Users/manishkumar/Desktop/money-printer && npx jest --testPathPattern="local-market-watchdog.service.spec" --no-coverage --runInBand --forceExit 2>&1 | tail -10`

3. Run risk management tests: `cd /Users/manishkumar/Desktop/money-printer && npx jest --testPathPattern="risk-management|daily-loss|execution.service" --no-coverage --runInBand --forceExit 2>&1 | tail -10`

Report results as:
```
🔁 Regression check for critical module
✓/❌ TypeScript: clean / N errors
✓/❌ Watchdog suite: N passed
✓/❌ Risk/Execution suite: N passed
```

If any test fails, identify the root cause and fix the underlying code issue. Do NOT weaken or delete failing tests.
